comment_regular: Oblivion lazy INFO result-script loader. For a newly requested INFO, initializes a fresh shared temporary Script, opens the winning override record saved by the main INFO loader, and replays its entire chunk stream. Recognized result-script tags are SCHR, SCDA, and SCRO only. SCHD, SCTX, SLSD, SCVR, and SCRV are ignored. Repeated SCHR prefix-overlays ScriptInfo, repeated SCDA replaces compiled storage/size, and every SCRO appends in stream order. No inherited base-script state is reconstructed for a partial override.
